                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h3 data-id="heading-0">前言</h3>
<p>来到字节快一年了，最初的我满怀憧憬，以为大厂的代码一定是高深莫测、充满黑科技的艺术品。然而，深入项目后才发现，这里的代码并没有想象中那么“高大上”，反而透着一股朴实无华的实用主义！</p>
<p>今天主要说说这些朴实无华的实用主义！</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-1">往期精彩推荐</h4>

<h3 data-id="heading-2">正文</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">朴实无华的内联原则</h4>
<p>首先，我先来说说第一次提交 MR 请求时，RV 的最多的问题：请用内联！</p>
<p><strong>我以前的强迫症习惯（零散示例）</strong>：</p>
<p>以前的习惯：常量必须放文件顶部！函数必须定义变量！</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Button</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Form</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Select</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"@arco-design/web-react"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sameOptions = [
  { <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'apple'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'Apple'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'banana'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'Banana'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'cherry'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'Cherry'</span> },
];

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">FormSelect</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [form] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Form</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">useForm</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">submit</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(form.<span class="hljs-title function_">getFiledsValue</span>());
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Form</span> <span class="hljs-attr">form</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{form}</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span> <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"samelabel"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">field</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"same"</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">select</span> <span class="hljs-attr">options</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{sameOptions}</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span> &gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{submit}</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Button</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Form</span>&gt;</span></span>
    
  );
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FormSelect</span>;
</code></pre>
<p>这种方式看似简洁，但在大项目中，文件多了，变量散了，容易造成“阅读障碍”。</p>
<p>现在，看内联方式</p>
<p><strong>内联方式（朴实示例）</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Button</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Form</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Select</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"@arco-design/web-react"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">FormSelect</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [form] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Form</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">useForm</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Form</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span> <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"samelabel"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">field</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"same"</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">select</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">options</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{[</span>
            { <span class="hljs-attr">value:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">apple</span>', <span class="hljs-attr">label:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">Apple</span>' },
            { <span class="hljs-attr">value:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">banana</span>', <span class="hljs-attr">label:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">Banana</span>' },
            { <span class="hljs-attr">value:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">cherry</span>', <span class="hljs-attr">label:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">Cherry</span>' },
          ]}
        /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span> &gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> console.log(form.getFiledsValue())}&gt;<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Button</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Form.Item</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Form</span>&gt;</span></span>
    
  );
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FormSelect</span>;
</code></pre>
<p>这种代码更紧凑，一眼就能看懂逻辑。不用来回翻看跳转！日常维护也更容易一些！</p>
<p>当然，不是无脑内联，如果包含函数很复杂的计算，还是要求定义变量，因为每次 render 都进行复杂的计算，会导致页面卡顿！</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">朴实无华的变量</h4>
<p>还一个容易出现零散问题的地方：定义变量！</p>
<p><strong>我以前的习惯</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [a, setA] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [b, setB] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [c, setC] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onAchange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">val</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">setA</span>(val);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onBchange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">val</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">setB</span>(val);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onCchange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">val</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">setC</span>(val);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>相信很多小伙伴都会这么写变量吧，但是这种在我们组是很难被通过的代码，因为同样会导致找不到变量在哪的情况！</p>
<p>我们组的方案，是使用了一个 <code>useSetState</code> 的 <code>hook</code> 定义，它返回常用的 <code>state</code> 还会返回一个 <code>ref state</code> ！</p>
<p>先看看现在的写法吧！</p>
<p><strong>现在的习惯</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
    state,
    setRefState,
    getRefState
  } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useSetState</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">a</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">b</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">c</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
  })
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onChange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">a, b, c</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">setResState</span>({ a, b, c })
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>这么写的好处，除了前面说到的变量在一块，方便查找外，还额外提供了 <code>ref state</code> ，如果页面仅仅是读取状态，那么可以使用它来减少无意义的页面渲染！</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-html" lang="html"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>{getRefState().a}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">朴实无华的中间量和函数定义</h4>
<p>另外一个 RV 的出现多次问题，就是因为我使用了 <code>useCallback</code> 还有 <code>useMemo</code>！</p>
<p>其实当如入职，组里的新手指引里，明确写了尽量不要使用他们，但是我写项目的时候还是用了，结果就是卡在这里无法通过 Merge ！</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { state } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useSetState</span>({})
  
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 不要使用 useMemo</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> d = state.<span class="hljs-property">a</span> + state.<span class="hljs-property">b</span>;
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 不要使用 useCallback</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onChange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">val</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/**todo**/</span>
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">朴实无法的组件定义</h4>
<p>另外，给我很大震撼的是，我刚刚接手项目，一个文件居然放了好几个小组件和一个页面组件！</p>
<p>慢慢了解后才知道，原来是这样的：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>1. 如果其他地方没有用到，不允许拆封组件（内联原则）</strong></li>
<li><strong>2. 一个页面的组件在多个地方使用才拆封组件，不考虑以后</strong></li>
<li><strong>3.一个页面的功能组件，尽量保留在一个文件里（不过度拆封文件）</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>具体的例子就不展示了，但是表达的意思就是：不要过度组件化、多文件化！</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">朴实无华的数据与 UI 的分离</h4>
<p>大厂项目强调可复用性，尤其是大型模块。数据逻辑（如 API 调用、状态管理）和 UI 渲染（如组件布局）如果耦合太紧，复用起来就麻烦。</p>
<p>关于状态分离，也有要求：<strong>没有跨页面跨模块的逻辑和 UI 没必要分离！</strong></p>
<p>因为会破坏阅读代码的流畅性！</p>
<p>如果分离，我们组有专门的高阶组件工具！</p>
<p>下面是示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { createStore } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"@/utils"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useSetState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"@/hooks"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"react"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useMaterialStore</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  
 <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
    state,
    setRefState,
    getRefState
  } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useSetState</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">a</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">b</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">c</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
  })
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    state,
    <span class="hljs-attr">d</span>: get () =&gt; state.<span class="hljs-property">a</span> + state.<span class="hljs-property">b</span>,
    setRefState,
    getRefState
  };
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
  useStore,
  withStoreProvider
} = <span class="hljs-title function_">createStore</span>(useMaterialStore);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> {
  withStoreProvider,
  useStore
} <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./store"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Other</span> fron <span class="hljs-string">"./Other.tsx"</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Index</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { state, d } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useStore</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Other</span> /&gt;</span></span>;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">withStoreProvider</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Index</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>这样，Index 下的任意组件都可以使用 <code>useStore</code> 共享数据了！</p>
<p>UI 组件只需订阅 <code>useStore</code>，逻辑复用更灵活。</p>
<p>下面是我自己实现的 <code>createStore</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { createContext, useContext } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"react"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> type { <span class="hljs-title class_">PropsWithChildren</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">ReactNode</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"react"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> createStore&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">TStore</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-attr">initializer</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">TStore</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">StoreContext</span> = createContext&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">TStore</span>&gt;({} <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">TStore</span>);

  <span class="hljs-comment">// Provider 组件</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">StoreProvider</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ children }: { children: ReactNode }</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> store = <span class="hljs-title function_">initializer</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> 
      <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">StoreContext.Provider</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{store}</span>
      &gt;</span>{children}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">StoreContext.Provider</span>&gt;</span></span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// Hook：获取 store</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useStore</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">TStore</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> store = <span class="hljs-title function_">useContext</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">StoreContext</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!store) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"useStore must be used within a StoreProvider"</span>);
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> store;
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 高阶组件：自动包裹 Provider</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">withStoreProvider</span>(<span class="hljs-params">
    Component: (props: unknown) =&gt; ReactNode
  </span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>.<span class="hljs-property">FC</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">PropsWithChildren</span>&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">props: unknown</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">StoreProvider</span>&gt;</span>{Component(props)}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">StoreProvider</span>&gt;</span></span>;
    };
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { useStore, withStoreProvider };
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">最后</h3>
<p>在字节写代码，就是这么朴实无华且枯燥！而且还有很多实用的小技巧，有时间我在分享给大家！</p>
